SignTool Error: An unexpected internal error has occurred.

checks: msix-built (required): an .msix exists under the project folder
signed-by-pfx (required): its signer is the certificate in certs\northwind.pfx
publisher-matches (required): the package's Publisher equals the certificate subject
installed (required): Northwind.Viewer is installed and its app runs SimpleApp.exe
launches (required): activating the installed app starts it from the package
